socialHook: Update: GTA Online's Halloween event concludes Oct 29-Nov 4 with Kortz Center Heist bonuses and Karin Previon Prize Ride.

sections.heading: Halloween Event Concludes with Final Weekly Update
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL reports that the month-long GTA Online Halloween event draws to a close with the weekly update running from October 29 to November 4, 2026. The update marks the final rotation of seasonal content, bringing back familiar spooky rewards and introducing fresh bonuses for the week.
According to the publication, Rockstar has rotated various content and applied significant bonuses across multiple activities, signaling the end of the Halloween-themed event period.

sections.heading: Kortz Center Heist and Priority File Bonuses
paragraphs: The Kortz Center Heist receives new Primary Targets, a reset first-completion bonus, and an additional GTA$400,000 for completing the heist without dying, RockstarINTEL notes.
Meanwhile, the FIB Priority File for the week is The Project Breakaway File, which pays double the usual reward, providing a lucrative opportunity for players engaging in contact missions.

sections.heading: Vehicle Rewards and Showroom Rotations
paragraphs: At the Diamond Casino, the Lucky Wheel offers the Progen GP1 (normally $1,260,000) as the podium vehicle, with GTA+ members receiving two spins per 24-hour period.
The LS Car Meet Prize Ride is the Karin Previon ($1,490,000), unlocked by placing top five in an LS Car Meet Race for two consecutive days.

This week’s Premium Test Ride is the Maibatsu MonstroCiti for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC Enhanced players, while the Test Track features the Declasse Vamos, Dewbauchee Seven-70, and Ocelot Locust.

Luxury Autos in Rockford Hills showcases the Dewbauchee Rapid GT X and Übermacht Sentinel XS4, and Simeon’s Auto Shop offers the Albany Brigham, Albany Fränken Stange, Albany Lurcher, Declasse Tornado Rat Rod, and LCC Sanctus for purchase and test drives.
